categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, and maintenance services of micro-nano direct write lithography equipment. Its primary product lines include PCB direct imaging equipment and automation lines, general semiconductor direct write lithography equipment and automation lines, and other laser direct imaging equipment. The company serves both the PCB industry and the broader semiconductor industry, including IC mask making, IC substrates, advanced packaging, display lithography, and photovoltaic applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on micro-nano direct write lithography technology, including UV optical lithography, laser direct imaging (LDI), and maskless lithography. It develops high-precision motion platforms, advanced laser light sources, dynamic environmental control systems, and intelligent direct write lithography systems based on deep learning algorithms. Production involves standardized and customized manufacturing, with core components either self-developed or procured from qualified suppliers, and some non-core processes outsourced. The company employs integrated product development (IPD) management for R&D and maintains strict procurement and quality control systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading PCB manufacturers and semiconductor companies in China and internationally, including top 100 PCB firms and major players in IC substrates, advanced packaging, mask making, new display technologies, and photovoltaic sectors. The company has strategic partnerships with firms such as Japanese VTEC, Deep South Circuit, and Pengding Holdings. Its products serve end markets like communications, consumer electronics, computing, automotive electronics, industrial control, medical devices, defense, aerospace, and emerging fields like AI, 5G, and new energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hefei and subsidiaries in Suzhou and Shenzhen. It has expanded its international footprint with sales and service teams in Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, and Australia. The company is actively developing its presence in Thailand and other Southeast Asian countries to capture the industry shift towards these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of high-end lithography equipment used by downstream PCB and semiconductor manufacturers. It also engages in upstream R&D and partial component development to ensure core technology and supply chain autonomy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company aims to become a world-leading domestic brand in direct write lithography machines, focusing on continuous R&D innovation, product iteration, and expansion into new application fields such as advanced packaging, new displays, and photovoltaic manufacturing. It emphasizes core component self-development, integration of industry resources, and building a high-end equipment supply chain. The company invests heavily in IPD-based R&D, collaborates with top universities and research institutes, and pursues international market expansion and localization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of lithography equipment to PCB and semiconductor manufacturers, supplemented by periodic maintenance and technical support services. The company also offers limited equipment leasing services, generating rental income during lease periods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Heidelberg, Orbotech (now part of KLA), ADTEC, SCREEN, and ORC in the lithography equipment market. It is recognized as a domestic leader and one of the earliest direct write lithography equipment developers in China, with technology and market share rapidly catching up to international competitors. The company leverages its local service advantages and cost-effectiveness to gain market share, especially in the growing domestic and Southeast Asian markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 828.9 million, a 27.07% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 179.3 million, up 31.28%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.48 billion, growing 60.38% from the previous year, supported by a successful RMB 798 million private placement. R&D investment accounted for 11.41% of revenue, with a strong growth trajectory driven by expanding PCB and semiconductor markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, stability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its direct write lithography equipment, tailored to meet the evolving high-end demands of PCB and semiconductor manufacturing. Its products support finer line widths, higher throughput, and advanced features like intelligent correction and automation. Localized service and rapid response capabilities provide a competitive edge over foreign suppliers. The company’s broad product matrix covers multiple application scenarios, enabling it to serve diverse customer needs and accelerate domestic substitution of imported equipment.
